# Example: C++ Vector

#### Course: Learn C++ STL

## Example: C++ Vector

```cpp
1#include <iostream>
2#include <vector>
3using namespace std;
4
5int main() {
6
7
8
9    // Initialize an integer vector
10    vector<int> numbers = {59, 49, 39, 29, 19};
11
12    // Display vector elements with ranged loop
13    for(int var : numbers) {
14        cout << var << endl;
15    }
16
17    return 0;
18}
```

Output

```text
59
49
39
29
19
```

In the above example, we have created a vector named numbers that store 5 integer values.

```cpp
vector<int> numbers = {59, 49, 39, 29, 19};
```

Here we have used a ranged for loop to print the vector.
